# searchstax_zookeeper_config (Resource)

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `deployment_uid` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import an existing ZooKeeper configuration with `account_name/deployment_uid/name`.

```shell
terraform import searchstax_zookeeper_config.example account_name/deployment_uid/name
```
